transcription: Main factsheet text only (site header and menus, the CPI program left nav, 'Related Information' links, the 'Last modified date: February 9, 2023' line and the footer removed). Tables 1–4 are kept as pipe-separated rows with their header rows ('Quantity | Representation | Value'); cells the page leaves empty are kept as empty cells ('Index value, December 2021 |  | 278.802'). The two 'critical points to remember' are kept as • items. Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: CPI percent-change computation — the stated one-month procedure (subtract the earlier index value from the later one, divide by the earlier value, multiply by 100) with four worked tables: 1-month change (278.802 − 277.948 = 0.854; 0.854 / 277.948 = 0.003; × 100 = 0.3%), 12-month change December 2021 to December 2022 (17.995 / 278.802 = 0.065 → 6.5%), the annual average (12 monthly values summing to 3251.637 divided by 12 = 270.970), and the annual-average percent change (21.685 / 270.970 = 0.080 → 8.0%). Fits a formula explorer for percent change, step ordering of the procedure, and quiz cards predict-then-reveal on each worked table.
